name: Jataka
desc: The core branch — reading the individual's birth chart to reveal personality, life path, strengths, weaknesses, and timing of events through Dashas and transits.
details: Uses D1 (Rasi) as the foundation, supported by Navamsa (D9) and other divisional charts. The most widely practiced branch.

name: Muhurta
desc: Selecting auspicious moments for initiating important activities — marriage, business launch, travel, construction, mantra initiation, etc.
details: Analyzes Panchanga, Tarabala (Nakshatra compatibility), Chandrabala, and other factors to find the most favorable time window.

name: Prashna
desc: Answering specific questions based on the chart cast for the moment the question is asked — no birth data required.
details: Uses the Prashna chart's Ascendant, Moon, and relevant house significators. Arudha Lagna and Chatra Rasi are key techniques.

name: Varshaphala
desc: Solar return chart analysis — predicting the year ahead from birthday to birthday using Tajika system techniques.
details: Casts a chart for the exact moment the Sun returns to its natal degree. Uses Tajika Yogas, Muntha (progressed Ascendant), and Mudda Dasha.

name: Nadi Jyotisha
desc: Ancient palm-leaf manuscript system containing life readings organized by thumbprint patterns. Claims to reveal past, present, and future.
details: Originated from great sages (Agastya, Bhrigu, Sukra etc.). The native is identified by thumbprint, then corresponding leaf is read. Unique to India.

name: Ayur Jyotisha
desc: Diagnosing health conditions and determining treatment approaches through planetary positions and their body part significations.
details: Each planet rules specific body parts, organs, and diseases (e.g., Saturn for chronic/lingering conditions, Mars for acute/inflammatory, Rahu for mysterious/untreatable). Used alongside Ayurveda.

name: Samhita
desc: Predicting national and global events — elections, earthquakes, wars, economic trends, agricultural output, and natural disasters.
details: Uses ingress charts (Sun into Aries), New/Full Moon charts, eclipses, and planetary conjunctions. Varahamihira's Brihat Samhita is the foundational text.

name: Kuta Milan
desc: Evaluating marriage/partnership compatibility through a point-based system comparing the couple's Nakshatras, Rashis, and other factors.
details: Assesses 8-10 factors: Varna (caste), Vashya (control), Tara (star), Yoni (nature), Graha Maitri (friendship), Gana (temperament), Bhakoota (heart), Nadi (health). Minimum 18/36 points required.
